Context: 2. Non-ACC cases:

- (h) Procedure to be followed when the Appointing Authority does not agree with Recommendations of DPC.There may be certain occasions when the appointing authority may find it necessary to disagree with the recommendations of the DPC. Where the appointing authority, being lower than the President of India, does not agree with the recommendations of the DPC, such appointing authority should indicate the reasons for disagreeing and refer the entire matter to the DPC for reconsideration of its earlier
